preference_notes: I want to lose visceral fat.
I need easy high-protein options between classes.

response.calorie_rationale: No structured serving rows or body weight were provided, so a numeric calorie target can’t be anchored reliably. For visceral fat loss, use a modest calorie deficit while keeping protein high enough to preserve lean mass.
response.meal_pattern: Eat protein at every meal and build easy portable snacks between classes. Favor 3 meals plus 1-2 high-protein snacks, with each snack centered on 20-30 g protein if possible.
response.sleep_note: If you’re often tired, prioritize regular meals with protein and fiber; blood-sugar swings from sugary, low-protein snacks can worsen energy crashes. If fatigue persists, consider checking sleep, hydration, and iron/B12 status.
response.summary: Higher protein intake supports fat loss and helps preserve lean mass during calorie restriction. For visceral fat loss and better energy, keep meals simple: protein plus fiber-rich plants and healthy fats. Between classes, choose portable options like yogurt, eggs, edamame, tuna, jerky, nuts, or a protein shake. Limit fried and highly processed foods, and keep saturated fat modest.
